- Pilot footprint: ~200M tokens/month initially (2-month pilot), with a target ramp to ~1.5B tokens/month by Q4.
- In-scope features: multi-turn chat assist, document summarization, embeddings-based search/rerank.
- FintechX target price range mentioned: $70 - $110 per 1M tokens; preference to hit <= $80 if possible under an annual commit.

- Modeled list price scenarios: $80 / $95 / $110 per 1M tokens (we used $95 mid-case for pilot modeling).

Asks for FintechX so we can finish the workbook:
1) Confirm pilot and target monthly token buckets (200M pilot, 800M mid, 1.5B target are in the sheet).
2) Confirm which features you want token-metered vs bundle-priced (you indicated embeddings may be billed separately).
3) Procurement preferences: desired commit term (12/24 months), invoicing cadence, and any required SLA language.

I'm attaching redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx and unit-econ-breakdown.pdf (includes per-feature $/call math and CAC-payback scenarios). Proposed 30m follow-up: Thu Jun 18 10:00 AM PT. Will bring Aditya for technical per-call math and Laura for commercial options.

Hi Samir \u2014 attaching the high-level per-feature math here so you can preview before I drop numbers in the sheet. If you send telemetry I will replace the illustrative values.

Assumptions: 8B quantized serving profile; baseline infra cost = $30 / 1M tokens. Modeled prices: $80/$95/$110 per 1M.

Per-feature examples (illustrative)
- Chat turn (single user turn)
  Avg tokens/turn: 600
  Infra cost/turn = (600/1,000,000) * $30 = $0.018
  Revenue/turn @ $95/1M = (600/1,000,000) * $95 = $0.057
  Gross margin/turn ~= $0.039 (~68%)

- Multi-turn session (5 turns avg)
  Tokens/session: 5 * 600 = 3,000
  Infra cost/session = (3,000/1,000,000) * $30 = $0.09
  Revenue/session @ $95/1M = 3,000/1,000,000 * $95 = $0.285
  Gross margin/session ~= $0.195 (~68%)

- Long doc summarization
  Tokens/job: 2,500
  Infra cost/job = (2,500/1,000,000) * $30 = $0.075
  Revenue/job @ $95/1M = $0.2375
  Gross margin/job ~= $0.1625 (~68%)

CAC payback simple example
- Pilot user model: 1,000 MAUs, 3 chat turns/day, 30 days -> tokens/user/month = 54,000
- Infra cost/user/month = 54,000/1,000,000 * $30 = $1.62
- Revenue/user/month @ $95/1M = 54,000/1,000,000 * $95 = $5.13
- Contribution margin/user/month = $3.51
- With CAC = $50 -> payback ~= 14.2 months (over 12mo target)

Ways to get to <=12 months:
- Committed pricing / prepay discounts (we can model a 10-20% reduction on list price for 12mo commit).
- Performance tuning: caching & batching improvements can reduce infra cost ~10-30% depending on request shape.
- Product packaging: surface higher-value features as add-ons to increase ARPU.

I'll add these lines into the spreadsheet and provide best/worst cases for 200M, 800M, and 1.5B token buckets. If you can share telemetry before Thu I'll update the numbers live.

Regards,
